evidence.summary: Plain ASCII, one script: no hidden letters.
Not State Bank of India's: it contains the brand name 'sbi', but no ownership proof matched (no brand-owned ending, restricted registry or official-list entry).
Closeness to sbi.bank.in is 0.71 (the brand token is exact).
No certificate of a proven State Bank of India name lists sbicard.com (family auto-discovery: 47 names linked, 2026-11-06).
In the message, 'sbi' leads the link, so it reads as an official address.
ML risk 0.25: the PhiUSIIL model reads like the dataset's ordinary sites (no subdomains, short host). Supporting signal only: it can't see look-alikes.
Page not opened: Doppel never visits unknown domains. This verdict rests on the name evidence alone.

Its OV certificate names a validated company: "SBI CARDS AND PAYMENT SERVICES LIMITED" (Corporation Service Company). That is not State Bank of India's legal name (STATE BANK OF INDIA): a certificate proves who runs a site, not who that company belongs to.
